# Vaxo

> Vaxo (vaxogroup.com) is a full-cycle digital studio run with AI: websites and online stores, mobile apps and SaaS, AI chat assistants and automation, paid ads (Meta, Google, TikTok), SMM, SEO, design, short-form video and AI-animated brand characters. Clients worldwide; English, Ukrainian and Russian.

## Key facts
- AI manager "Vax" answers clients 24/7 on the site, in Telegram and by email; a human manager joins for calls.
- Starter packages (one-time, 7 days): one automation $149, one-page website $199, AI chat assistant for a website $249.
- Typical ranges: landing page $400–1,500; multi-page site $900–3,500; online store $1,500–6,000; app MVP $3,000–12,000; ads management $300–1,500/month; SMM $250–1,200/month.
- Payment: starter packages 100% upfront; projects from $1,000 — 50/50. Refund rules: https://vaxogroup.com/terms/
- Partner program (18+): 30% of the first order + 10% of later payments for life; 40% if the partner also closes the deal. https://vaxogroup.com/partners/
- Real cases: AiPro Partners, TrichoTech.
